{{Quote|Folks in cloaks headed that way yester morn.|The Agamarian farmer|<ref name="Legacy (2006) 45" />}}
A '''farmer''' was a [[Agamarian|native]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Agamar/Legends|Agamar]] during the [[Second Imperial Civil War]]. When representatives of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] met with deposed [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Roan Fel]] on Agamar, the [[Farmer/Legends|farmer]] was approached by [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Morrigan Corde|Nyna Calixte]] while riding his [[Agamarian beast]] and paid to direct her towards the meeting point. Taking his beast as transport, Calixte charged the farmer with hiding her [[Starship/Legends|ship]] and promised to pay him for his services on her return.<ref name="Legacy (2006) 45" />
